sn12.55:1.2: upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.55:1.5: evame tassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
sn12.55:2.2: tassa yāni ceva mūlāni adhogamāni yāni ca tiriyaṅgamāni sabbāni tāni uddhaṃ ojaṃ abhiharanti
sn12.55:2.3: evañhi so bhikkhave mahā rukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya
sn12.55:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.55:2.6: evame tassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
sn12.55:3.1: upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
sn12.55:4.2: atha puriso āgac cheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya
sn12.55:4.3: so taṃ rukkhaṃ mūle chindeyya mūle chetvā palikhaneyya palikhanitvā mūlāni uddhareyya antamaso usīra nāḷimattānipi.
sn12.55:4.4: so taṃ rukkhaṃ khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya khaṇḍā khaṇḍikaṃ chinditvā phāleyya phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā vātātape visoseyya
sn12.55:4.5: vātātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya agginā ḍahetvā masiṃ kareyya masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā ophuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya
sn12.55:4.6: evañhi so bhikkhave mahā rukkho ucchinnamūlo assa tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅgato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo
sn12.55:4.7: evameva kho bhikkhave upā dāniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
